description: Plugin kernel with reversible effects, typed service discovery and cascade unload, with React and Vue bindings.
rules: Never mutate the kernel during render: kernel.load/unload and scope.provide/contribute belong in event handlers, effects, or bootstrap.
Tokens are imported symbols from one contract module, never string literals at call sites.
Prefer <Requires of={[Token]}> over useService(Token)! so removal unmounts the dependent subtree.
After an await inside setup, check scope.active before provide or contribute.
